description: Estimate the credit cost of running a paid operation (dub / subtitles / ai_package) across every CONVERTED video in a folder and compare it to the current balance — WITHOUT executing anything. ai_package = eBook + mind map + quiz in target_langs (default 1 language), 1 credit/min per resource per language, minus the free daily AI quota of an active Gold/Enterprise plan (1 use per video × resource); resources the videos already have aren't subtracted (panda_action_enable_ai_package_for_folder with dry_run=true gives the exact preview). Read-only; use before the real action to decide whether to proceed.

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

target_langs.description: Target languages (for dub/subtitles/ai_package); count drives the cost

title: Credit Preflight
